question: Where is the nearest hospital along the direction of travel from Leon and Ethel Yeiser Rose Garden, Annville, PA to Main Street Inn, Boutique Hotel, Kutztown, PA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.51439 40.331543)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.78021 40.514338)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'hospital'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.51439 40.331543)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.51439 40.331543)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;
